Quota System — Complete Reference Guide
How each quota works, eligibility, and counselling implications
All India Quota (AIQ)
381 MBBS groups · Avg closing rank 4,18,761
15% of seats in all government medical colleges (except J&K) surrendered to central MCC counselling. Highly competitive — ranks cut off much earlier than state quota. Includes SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD sub-categories. MCC conducts 3 rounds + stray vacancy round.
Open Seat Quota (AIIMS / JIPMER)
36 MBBS groups · Central Institutes
Used exclusively for AIIMS (13 campuses), JIPMER Puducherry/Karaikal, and ESIC/VMMC. 100% seats filled through MCC. Extremely competitive for flagship campuses. Different category sub-seats: UR, OBC-NCL, SC, ST, EWS, PwD.
Deemed / Paid Seats
68 MBBS groups · Management + NRI sub-quota
Seats in Deemed Universities (Manipal, Kasturba, JSS, etc.) filled through MCC Deemed counselling. Higher fees (₹10–25L/year). Closing ranks usually much weaker than government colleges. High upgradation as students prefer government seats.
Non-Resident Indian (NRI)
60 MBBS groups · Wide rank range
15% of seats in Deemed Universities reserved for NRI students or close relatives. Fees in USD. Rank cutoff often extremely wide (closing rank 8–13 lakh) due to fewer eligible candidates. Counselled by MCC separately.
Delhi University / NCR Quota
6 MBBS groups · Delhi-domicile preference
Seats in Delhi government medical colleges (LHMC, MAMC, UCMS, VMMC, ABVIMS). 85% reserved for Delhi-domicile candidates. Remaining 15% goes to AIQ. Very competitive within Delhi domicile pool.
ESI / Employee Quota
9 MBBS groups · ESIC hospitals
Seats at ESIC Medical Colleges reserved for Insured Persons (IPs) and dependents. Eligibility requires ESIC membership. 50% seats for ESI beneficiaries; remaining go to AIQ. ESIC PGIMSR Joka, Hyderabad, Bengaluru covered.
IP University Quota (Delhi)
3 MBBS groups · ABVIMS, VMMC, ESIC Delhi
Seats managed by Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. Delhi-domicile students may have preference. ESIC Medical College Faridabad is a major institution. Counselling through IP University in addition to MCC.
Minority Quotas (AMU / Jamia / Jain)
AMU · Jamia · Jain Minority · Muslim Minority
AMU Quota: 50% seats at JNMC AMU reserved for Muslims. Jamia Internal: 50% at Jamia Faculty of Dentistry. Jain Minority: SBKS Medical (Piparia). Wide closing ranks due to restricted eligible pool.

Category Reservation Applicable Quotas Key Notes
Unreserved (UR/General)40.5%AIQ, Open, DeemedOpen to all. Highest cut-off ranks.
EWS10%AIQ, OpenIncome ≤ ₹8L/year, no SC/ST/OBC status. Competent authority certificate required.
OBC-NCL27%AIQ, OpenCentral OBC list (non-creamy layer). State OBC ≠ Central OBC. Closing ranks ~1.3× UR.
SC15%AIQ, Open, StateDistrict authority certificate. Closing ranks significantly weaker than UR.
ST7.5%AIQ, Open, StateSmallest pool — closing ranks can be extremely weak. High year-on-year volatility.
